title: Robot Presence
description: The connection state of a robot agent, published with a last-will-and-testament so an offline event is instant.

robot_id.description: Unique lowercase DNS label identifier for the robot.

online.description: True if the agent is connected, false otherwise.

stamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision.

version.description: Software version the agent is running; sent when it announces itself online.

reason.description: Why the robot is offline: 'last will' when the broker published it after the connection died, 'agent stopped' when the agent said so itself.
